verdict.rationale: Viam's docs claim 'Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting' and general fleet management (remote monitoring, OTA updates), plus a machine status API (GetMachineStatus) that reports resource health and failure reasons, which could underlie fault detection. However, there's no detail on configuring specific alert types (battery thresholds, connectivity loss notifications), no evidence of notification channels (email/SMS/Slack), and no independent confirmation this alerting actually works in practice. Missing for 10: documented alert configuration UI/API, battery-specific and connectivity-specific alert triggers, notification delivery mechanisms, and hands-on/independent validation of the alerting feature.
